relationships.subject: remifentanil
relationships.evidence_quote: The current study showed that the intraoperative infusion of remifentanil activated the NLRLP3 inflammasome by improving the expression of NLRP3, TLR4, P2X7R, and caspase-1 in the spinal cords of rats (Figure 5).

relationships.subject: remifentanil
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, the increased phospho-NR1 and decreased GLT-1 protein levels were identified in spinal cords from the Remifentanil group compared with that of the Normal saline group

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggested that IL-1β contributes to RIH through the regulation of phospho-NR1 and GLT-1.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings proved that RIH depends on TLR4, P2X7R, and caspase-1 signaling.

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: It could therefore be concluded that spinal NLRP3 inflammasome activation caused RIH.

key_findings: Remifentanil activates the spinal NLRP3 inflammasome (NLRP3, TLR4, P2X7R, caspase-1 up), raising IL-1β and phospho-NR1 and lowering GLT-1.
Intrathecal IL-1ra, (+)-naloxone, A438079 or ac-YVAD-cmk attenuated hyperalgesia and reversed phospho-NR1/GLT-1 changes.
